# `armada rbac`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

Users are people and services are tools such as a CI system. Each holds
roles: viewer, deployer, or admin in a space (viewer also over the whole
cluster), space-creator, or cluster-admin. Only cluster-admin manages
access. `armada rbac role list` shows what each role allows.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada rbac assignment`](#armada-rbac-assignment) | Give roles to users and services, and take them back |
| [`armada rbac role`](#armada-rbac-role) | Show the built-in roles |
| [`armada rbac service`](#armada-rbac-service) | Manage services: tools such as a CI system |
| [`armada rbac user`](#armada-rbac-user) | Manage users: people, each with a certificate of their own |

## `armada rbac assignment`

Give roles to users and services, and take them back.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada rbac assignment create`](#armada-rbac-assignment-create) | Give a user or service a role |
| [`armada rbac assignment delete`](#armada-rbac-assignment-delete) | Take a role back from a user or service |
| [`armada rbac assignment list`](#armada-rbac-assignment-list) | List who holds which role where |

### `armada rbac assignment create`

Give a role: viewer (in --space, or without it over the whole cluster),
deployer or admin (in --space; not in default), space-creator, or
cluster-admin. It applies to the next call the user or service makes.

```
armada rbac assignment create (--user NAME | --service NAME) --role ROLE [--space P] [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada rbac assignment create --user ana --role deployer --space shop
armada rbac assignment create --service ci --role viewer
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--role string` | the role |
| `--service string` | the service |
| `--user string` | the user |

### `armada rbac assignment delete`

Take a role back. You cannot take cluster-admin from yourself.

```
armada rbac assignment delete (--user NAME | --service NAME) --role ROLE [--space P] [flags]
```

Also: `rm`.

Examples:

```bash
armada rbac assignment delete --user ana --role deployer --space shop
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--role string` | the role |
| `--service string` | the service |
| `--user string` | the user |

### `armada rbac assignment list`

List who holds which role where.

```
armada rbac assignment list [--user NAME | --service NAME] [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
| `--service string` | the service |
| `--user string` | the user |

## `armada rbac service`

Manage services: tools such as a CI system.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada rbac service create`](#armada-rbac-service-create) | Create a service |
| [`armada rbac service credentials`](#armada-rbac-service-credentials) | Write a client config for a service |
| [`armada rbac service delete`](#armada-rbac-service-delete) | Delete a service and revoke every certificate of it |
| [`armada rbac service list`](#armada-rbac-service-list) | List services and their roles |
| [`armada rbac service renew`](#armada-rbac-service-renew) | Renew the certificate of a service's client config |
| [`armada rbac service show`](#armada-rbac-service-show) | Show a service's roles and allowed node labels |
| [`armada rbac service update`](#armada-rbac-service-update) | Replace the node labels a service's apps may require |

### `armada rbac service create`

Create a service, a tool that uses the API, with a first role (in --space
for viewer, deployer, and admin). Give it a client config with
`armada rbac service credentials`, and more roles with
`armada rbac assignment create`.

```
armada rbac service create NAME [--role ROLE [--space P]] [--allow-label KEY=VALUE]... [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada rbac service create ci --role deployer --space shop
armada rbac service create portal --role space-creator
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-label stringArray` | a node label KEY=VALUE its apps' placement may require (repeat for more) |
| `--role string` | a first role: viewer, deployer, admin (with --space), space-creator, or cluster-admin |

### `armada rbac service credentials`

Make a key here and a certificate for service NAME (90 days), and write a
client config to FILE (mode 0600). The tool uses it with `armada --config
FILE`, or the API with its PEM fields, and renews it with
`armada rbac service renew --config FILE`. Its other certificates stay valid
until it renews or is deleted.

```
armada rbac service credentials NAME -o FILE [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | client config file to create |

### `armada rbac service delete`

Revoke every certificate of the service, at once and on every server, and
take its roles back. You cannot delete yourself.

```
armada rbac service delete NAME --yes [flags]
```

Also: `rm`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--yes` | confirm deleting |

### `armada rbac service list`

List services and their roles.

```
armada rbac service list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

### `armada rbac service renew`

Run by the tool with its own client config (--config or ARMADA_CONFIG): get
a new 90-day certificate for a new key and rewrite the file. Every other
certificate of the service is revoked; the one in the file is replaced.

```
armada rbac service renew --config FILE
```

### `armada rbac service show`

Show a service's roles and allowed node labels.

```
armada rbac service show NAME [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

### `armada rbac service update`

Replace the node label values the apps a service deploys may name in
placement.require (armada.* labels are always allowed): restricted nodes
can be kept for some spaces. Roles change with `armada rbac assignment`.

```
armada rbac service update NAME (--allow-label KEY=VALUE... | --clear-labels) [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-label stringArray` | a node label KEY=VALUE its apps' placement may require (repeat for more) |
| `--clear-labels` | allow no node labels |

## `armada rbac user`

Manage users: people, each with a certificate of their own.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada rbac user create`](#armada-rbac-user-create) | Create a user with a certificate of their own |
| [`armada rbac user credentials`](#armada-rbac-user-credentials) | Write a new client config for a user, revoking their older certificates |
| [`armada rbac user delete`](#armada-rbac-user-delete) | Delete a user and revoke every certificate of it |
| [`armada rbac user list`](#armada-rbac-user-list) | List users and their roles |
| [`armada rbac user renew`](#armada-rbac-user-renew) | Renew the user certificate in your client config |
| [`armada rbac user show`](#armada-rbac-user-show) | Show a user's roles and allowed node labels |
| [`armada rbac user update`](#armada-rbac-user-update) | Replace the node labels a user's apps may require |

### `armada rbac user create`

Create a user and write their client config to FILE: a certificate under
their own name (one year) for a key made here. Give them FILE privately; they
keep it as ~/.armada/config, mode 0600. --role gives a first role (in
--space for viewer, deployer, and admin); give more with
`armada rbac assignment create`. A user with no role can only renew.

```
armada rbac user create NAME -o FILE [--role ROLE [--space P]] [--allow-label KEY=VALUE]... [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada rbac user create ana -o ana.config --role deployer --space shop
armada rbac user create ops -o ops.config --role cluster-admin
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-label stringArray` | a node label KEY=VALUE its apps' placement may require (repeat for more) |
| `-o`, `--output string` | client config file to create |
| `--role string` | a first role: viewer, deployer, admin (with --space), space-creator, or cluster-admin |

### `armada rbac user credentials`

Make a key here and a new certificate for user NAME (one year), and write
their client config to FILE. Certificates the user was given before stop
working: use it when a key is lost or leaked.

```
armada rbac user credentials NAME -o FILE [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | client config file to create |

### `armada rbac user delete`

Revoke every certificate of the user, at once and on every server, and
take its roles back. You cannot delete yourself.

```
armada rbac user delete NAME --yes [flags]
```

Also: `rm`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--yes` | confirm deleting |

### `armada rbac user list`

List users and their roles.

```
armada rbac user list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

### `armada rbac user renew`

Get a new one-year certificate for a new key, under the same name, and
rewrite the client config (--config, default ~/.armada/config, else
/etc/armada/admin.config, which needs sudo). Run it before the current
certificate expires: an expired one cannot renew. `armadad doctor` warns 30
days ahead. The old certificate stays valid until it expires. For one that
has expired, run `armadad user renew` as root on a server.

```
armada rbac user renew
```

### `armada rbac user show`

Show a user's roles and allowed node labels.

```
armada rbac user show NAME [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

### `armada rbac user update`

Replace the node label values the apps a user deploys may name in
placement.require (armada.* labels are always allowed): restricted nodes
can be kept for some spaces. Roles change with `armada rbac assignment`.

```
armada rbac user update NAME (--allow-label KEY=VALUE... | --clear-labels) [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-label stringArray` | a node label KEY=VALUE its apps' placement may require (repeat for more) |
| `--clear-labels` | allow no node labels |
